description: The exact itemized price of a stay, from the same engine as the booking page: the nightly rental by season, the meal plan, the 12% gratuity, the refundable security deposit, and any add-ons. Also says whether the dates are open, lists the add-ons, and gives a link that opens the booking page on this stay.

add_ons.description: Optional add-on codes from get_quote's add_ons_available (boat tour, spa, bonfire, ...); priced for the whole party.

check_in.description: Arrival date, YYYY-MM-DD. Arrival is from 2pm.

check_out.description: Departure date, YYYY-MM-DD. Departure is by noon.

children.description: Children aged 4 to 11. Adults and children together may not exceed 20.

toddlers.description: Children under 4: free, and not counted toward the 20.

name: get_quote
title: Price a stay
